description: This Java class defines static utility methods for handling spatial types (Geography and Geometry) in Apache Spark SQL, including conversions, serialization/deserialization, and spatial expression implementations.

classes.name: STUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for spatial data conversions, serialization, deserialization, and expression implementations in Spark SQL.

methods.name: fromPhysVal
methods.description: Converts a physical value to a Geography or Geometry object.

methods.name: toPhysVal
methods.description: Converts a Geography or Geometry object to its physical value.

methods.name: geographyToGeometry
methods.description: Casts a GeographyVal to a GeometryVal.

methods.name: serializeGeomFromWKB
methods.description: Serializes a Geometry object from WKB with SRID validation.

methods.name: serializeGeogFromWKB
methods.description: Serializes a Geography object from WKB with SRID validation.

methods.name: deserializeGeom
methods.description: Deserializes a GeometryVal to a Geometry object with SRID validation.

methods.name: deserializeGeog
methods.description: Deserializes a GeographyVal to a Geography object with SRID validation.

methods.name: stAsBinary
methods.description: Converts GeographyVal or GeometryVal to WKB binary.

methods.name: stGeogFromWKB
methods.description: Creates a GeographyVal from WKB binary.

methods.name: stGeomFromWKB
methods.description: Creates a GeometryVal from WKB binary, with optional SRID.

methods.name: stSetSrid
methods.description: Sets the SRID for GeographyVal or GeometryVal after validation.

methods.name: stSrid
methods.description: Retrieves the SRID from GeographyVal or GeometryVal.
